title: The Native plant of the marsh
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：native　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 native 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the tailor wrote of ① a native plant of the marsh in the order, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② so native that nobody in the shop would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the tailor, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the native ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the native plant of the marsh that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order for November 1961 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too native to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the native ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a native tongue of the island, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as native as the tongue of the island they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was native or not, and he said so.

By 1974 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the order. What the line asked for was ⑦ something native, and nothing besides. The customer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite native; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the order kept the names of the native ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1977, before dawn, she wrote of another native plant of the marsh in the same order, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less native than anybody had expected. ⑩ The native tongue of the island that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1979, was the one she could never quite name; the native ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 本地（前置定语 a native plant of the marsh：1967 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的那件本地的本土植物）
B. adj. 本地／土生（两处加强说法：so native that … 与 no less native than …）
C. adj. 本地／土生（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 本地（表语 too native to do：母亲觉得它太本地，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 土生（前置定语 a native tongue of the island：叔叔把整件事称作一桩土生的本地话）
F. adj. 土生（同级比较 as native as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩岛上的本地话相比）
G. adj. 土生（后置定语 something native：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 土生（受程度副词修饰 quite native：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a native plant of the marsh
the native plant of the marsh that
a native tongue of the island
The native tongue of the island that

answers.why: native 意为“本地”，1967 年裁缝在订单簿里记下的是“一件本地的本土植物”，此处作前置定语 a native plant of the marsh。
native 意为“本地”，此处用 so native that 结构，说它本地到裁缝铺里没人敢靠近。
native 意为“本地”，订单簿上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的本地湿地上的本土植物，等于最高级的说法。
native 意为“本地”，母亲认为这件东西“太本地了，谁也用不上”，too native to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
native 意为“土生”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩土生的本地话”，此处作前置定语 a native tongue of the island。
native 意为“土生”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩岛上的本地话一样土生”，同级比较用 as native as。
native 意为“土生”，订单簿上那半行字要的是“土生的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something native。
native 意为“土生”，邻裁缝铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当土生”，quite 修饰原级 native。
native 意为“土生”，no less native than 表示“其土生不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之土生不亚于任何人的预料。
native 意为“土生”，母亲 1979 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的土生本地话”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，裁缝在订单簿里记下了一件本地的本土植物。（a native plant of the marsh）
它本地到裁缝铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so native that …）
母亲觉得它太本地，谁也用不上。（too native to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩土生的本地话。（a native tongue of the island）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩岛上的本地话一样土生。（as native as …）
到了 1974 年，订单簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件土生的东西。（something native）
answers: In 1967 the tailor wrote of a native plant of the marsh in the order.
It was so native that nobody in the shop would go near it.
My mother thought it too native to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a native tongue of the island.
He said nobody would call it as native as the tongue of the island they had once had.
By 1974 the order asked for nothing but something native.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 native 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the tailor wrote of a native plant of the marsh in the order, and nobody forgot it.
It was the native plant of the marsh that anybody there had ever seen, or so the order says.
My mother thought it too native to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a native tongue of the island, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next shop called the plan quite native, and everybody laughed.
The native ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
